trials.answer: Because edges can be 0 or 1, use 0-1 BFS with a deque instead of ordinary BFS. Track distances and relax an edge only when it improves the neighbor’s distance; push improved zero-weight neighbors to the front and unit-weight neighbors to the back. Keep parent pointers updated on each improvement for path reconstruction—unlike unit-weight BFS, marking a vertex permanently visited when first enqueued is not valid. This runs in O(V + E) time and O(V) auxiliary space.
